query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'taskType',task_type,'objectType',object_type,'objectId',object_id,'title',title,'status',status,'priority',priority,'dueAt',due_at,'blockerCode',blocker_code,'version',version) ORDER BY due_at NULLS LAST,created_at),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.tasks WHERE assignee_user_id=$1
